rubricDispositions.rationale: Source, observation, source-unit, revision, and assembly-job keys are derived from tenant-scoped organization/connection-generation/channel/provider identity, and verified channel bindings are checked before key use; focused tests prove cross-organization and connection-generation keys do not alias.

The slice introduces no caller-facing capability; its capture validator requires an explicit verified Slack channel binding and rejects tenant, connection-generation, team/app/bot, channel, and external-channel mismatches before any durable rows are constructed.

Content-bearing artifact/revision rows start with active lifecycle envelopes and documented tombstone/redaction/purge/rollback behavior; row construction applies lifecycle metadata consistently and tests validate the durable row contract.

Receipt audit rows are separated from content-bearing revisions, revisions carry exact normalized text/blocks with lifecycle fences and canonical content hashes, and the task adds no logging or secret exposure path.

Duplicate transport delivery handling fingerprints immutable replay inputs and rejects drift as DuplicateKeyConflict, while the convex-test proof covers transaction rollback so a later failed write leaves no partial ledger state.

Live/backfill receipts converge on the same logical observation and revision keys, exact duplicate delivery replay returns duplicate, and same-delivery drift in identity, routing, metadata, lifecycle timestamp input, or content is rejected.
Assembly jobs are fenced by source revision, source unit, stable effect key, pinned policy epoch, lease fields, and lifecycle generation documentation; tests validate the pending job contract.

S05-T01 is a template-gap schema, table, test, and deterministic migration-registry slice; it introduces no live provider SDK import, provider adapter call, secret access, webhook body logging, or outbound delivery boundary.
